{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./with_gpu.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   -N 1         -> -N 1
#   -n 1         -> -n 1
#   -t 01:30:00  -> -t 1h30m
#   --gres=gpu:1 -> -g 1
#   -o with_gpu.out -> -o output=with_gpu.out
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -g 1 -t 1h30m -o output=with_gpu.out --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm -p gpu not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible GPU resources; you are not forcing the gpu partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --gres-flags=enforce-binding not translated.
  # Performance implication: without enforced GPU binding, the process may see different GPU assignment behavior; this can reduce performance or cause contention.

  # NOTE: Slurm -e with_gpu.err not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stderr will follow Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  module load cuda/12.2.2 gcc/10.2

  flux run -n 1 -g 1 nvidia-smi

  # Compile and run within the allocation
  flux run -n 1 -g 1 nvcc -O2 -std=c++11 hw4.cu -o a.out
  flux run -n 1 -g 1 nvprof ./a.out
  flux run -n 1 -g 1 nsys profile ./a.out
fi
"
}
